declaredRows.scenarioScope: Channel-scoped upload paused after the Accounts DO session check and before the durable commit; conservative policy requires rejection after committed revocation.
declaredRows.rationale: Frozen source10 deterministic test-only gate records real authentication, committed logout and actual Worker SQLite/R2 state; failures retained as regression evidence.

IRC and event observers receive message barriers and no race content, filename or new media ID; no post-recreation assertion was performed.

declaredRows.testTitle: [MEDIA-009 MEDIA-012 AUTH-011 DB-025] failed R2 put releases reservation even after originating session revocation
declaredRows.scenarioScope: R2 put failure after revocation; reservation row and quota remain because cleanup uses deletePrivateMedia with the revoked token.
declaredRows.rationale: Frozen source10 deterministic test-only gate records real authentication, committed logout and actual Worker SQLite/R2 state; failures retained as regression evidence.
assertionDetails: A Worker test-only bucket proxy pauses the actual route put after real R2 metadata reservation; the named separate DO gate signals reached, logout commits and denies the old token, then release injects a put failure.
The response is safe 503 and R2 objects remain unchanged, but an 18-byte reservation remains in media_uploads and counts against the owner quota; unrelated Bob object and subsequent upload survive.

Normal non-revoked injected put failure removes its reservation, successful uploads work, and IRC/event observers receive live barriers without race identifiers; no post-recreation assertion was performed.

phaseSpecificFindings.testTitle: [MEDIA-001 AUTH-011 DB-025] revoked upload cannot commit after authenticated channel scope was paused
phaseSpecificFindings.property: Pending channel-scoped SQLite upload rechecks committed bearer-session revocation before durable commit
phaseSpecificFindings.actual: Logout200 and independent stale-bearer401 occur before release, yet pending upload returns201 and inserts a21-byte metadata row and a SQLite chunk.
phaseSpecificFindings.controls: Actual valid uploads and an independent Bob file survive; real IRC/event barriers observe no race identifiers.
phaseSpecificFindings.notClaimed: No post-recreation assertion; only the exact raced operation state is evaluated, not all DB025 operations/transports.

phaseSpecificFindings.testTitle: [MEDIA-009 MEDIA-012 AUTH-011 DB-025] failed R2 put releases reservation even after originating session revocation

phaseSpecificFindings.controls: Normal failed put removes reservation, Bob upload/download and follow-up succeed, positive recipient barriers remain live.
phaseSpecificFindings.notClaimed: Not a failed file-size-limit check or stale-bearer authorization bypass; broad MEDIA009/AUTH011/DB025 labels on this second test do not all establish those properties failed.
